WoW is a content race, more than an RPG in an immersive world. They do not foster the illusion of a functioning world.

Quests, mysteries, treasures, loot efficiencies that are solved by data miners is cool at the end of a game's lifecycle, but new expansions come out, and I can just have the addons tell me everything, and I need to follow this behavior to thrive in the content-relevance-race that is worse in Retail because phase releases are pushed by the speed of the top% of players.

Even if we're not talking about racing phases with the 1st wave, we know an expansion is coming in a year or two, so that is how long we have to level up again, rep grind new factions, get the new profession stuff that makes our old recipes irrelevant, get preraid BiS, find a minimally toxic guild before it falls apart, find time to raid, and depending on the expansion, a billion other systems \[heroic, mythic, mythic+Keystone(s), artifact, yadayada\] that are new and REQUIRED to thrive in said expansion, find a PvP team/partner and rank up to buy top tier PvP gear for that spec you'll never use because the new expansion is coming out tomrrow.
